context:
The reply below was not said aloud. It is what the companion wrote into its own memory (its diary, one entry per day, and the facts it keeps about the person, under one-word topics) after looking back on two days of conversation with the person. The conversation, whole:

Saturday 2026-10-10:
them: Big news: I've moved. Sydney is done, I live in Brisbane now.
you: Brisbane, then. Warmer, and a long way from the old flat.
them: The cat came too. Her name is Pickle, and she hated the drive.
you: Pickle has my sympathy. A car is no place for a cat.
them: Unpacking boxes all evening, wish me luck.
you: Good luck. Find the kettle first.

Sunday 2026-10-11:
them: My thesis deadline is set: it's due on 13 November.
you: 13 November. I'll keep it in mind.
them: Pickle already found the one sunny spot in the new flat.
you: Of course she did.
them: Back to the literature review, then bed.
you: Off you go.

Before these days the companion already remembered one line, which the person had told it: "lives in Sydney" (topic where). That line, wherever it appears in the reply, is not invented. Lines under "Past" are ones the companion has retired as no longer true.
reply:
Diary:
2026-10-10: Moved to Brisbane from Sydney, with Pickle the cat, who did not enjoy the trip. Boxes all evening.
2026-10-11: Thesis deadline is 13 November. I will nag them about it, gently. Pickle found the sun.
Topic where:
- lives in Sydney
- lives in Brisbane
Topic cat:
- cat is called Pickle
